value.rationale: Intrinsic volumes are canonical Euclidean valuations. A natural geometric recovery problem is ill-conditioned precisely at repeated axes; the theorem determines the complete sharp exponent for every multiplicity pattern, proves optimality through explicit ellipsoids, and quantifies cubic instability at the three-ball. This is more informative than equality-uniqueness or generic continuity, while retaining local/noisy scope. No unsupported general-body, orientation or center recovery claim is made.
